text_block_list.text:
One day, that wonderful aroma drifted by 
once again.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The secret ingredient is a secret, so it's 
a se~cret~♪ Oguri-chan, please go ahead 
and wait.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Wait...? And this smell... could it be...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I made curry again today~. I'm 
reheating it on the stove right now, okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I wanted Oguri-chan to have some again~. 
So I made twice as much as last time♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Why do that?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Why, you ask? ...So Oguri-chan can eat as 
much as she wants without worrying~♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's not what I meant... Well, I am 
grateful, but...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Is it about ready? I'll serve it now, so 
don't eat too fast, alright?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Right, thanks for the food... wait, no.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oguri-chan?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Why do you take care of the other horse 
girls so much?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Why... why? Hmm, I wonder why...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
When asked so directly, it's a bit tough 
to say~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ah! Oguri-chan, oh dear!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...!? What happened?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The curry is getting overheated! I'll 
bring it over right away~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
......Creek! ...I like it piping hot 
too...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Yup, that was delicious!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I still haven't thought of an answer to 
your question, but... Seeing Oguri-chan's 
smile makes me so happy♪
